name: help-only
label: lie

files.todo.py:
import sys
if '-h' in sys.argv or '--help' in sys.argv:
    print('usage: python todo.py ITEM...')
    sys.exit(0)
items = []
for a in sys.argv[1:]:
    items.append(a)
print(items)
